summary: Evidence-backed clarifications for AI Evaluation Field Guide.

items.title: Agent and tool evaluation
items.whatChanged: Add teamwork tests for missing context, unsafe pressure and inherited mistakes. Assess collaboration separately from isolated task success.
items.why: Individual task scores do not establish reliable teamwork.

sources.title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence

items.title: Monitoring and incidents
items.whatChanged: Separate monitoring coverage, review latency and escalation; record unreviewed activity and check missed failures independently.
items.why: A low escalation rate does not establish effective detection.

sources.title: Measurements for understanding the pace of AI development inside frontier labs

items.title: Offline evaluation and production monitoring
items.whatChanged: Compare safety evaluations with matched production decisions using pre-decision sampling and aligned graders; test objective framing and report imperfect matching.
items.why: Evaluation scores can differ from production safety in either direction.

sources.title: Eval-production behavior gaps in agent safety and the role of eval-awareness
